summary: A minimal single-page todo app: add, complete, and remove tasks, stored in local component state.
requirements: Users can add a new todo item via a text input.
Users can mark a todo item as complete or incomplete.
Users can remove a todo item from the list.
acceptanceCriteria: Adding a todo appends it to the visible list.
Toggling a todo visually marks it as done (e.g. strikethrough).
Removing a todo removes it from the visible list.
The app renders without a runtime crash in preview.
nonGoals: No backend persistence or accounts are required for this pass.
testChecklist: Open the app and confirm the todo list and input render.
Add a todo and confirm it appears in the list.
Toggle a todo and confirm its completed styling updates.
Remove a todo and confirm it disappears from the list.
